summary: Ambev S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its interim consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, with an unqualified review report from PricewaterhouseCoopers. The filing is a routine periodic financial report under Rule 13a-16, not a special-situation event. No terms, stakes, premiums, or structural changes are mentioned. This is a standard quarterly update, equivalent to a U.S. Form 10-Q, with no actionable event or transactional element to track.
